description: Sixteen channels of fixed 1V/octave note voltages, with transposition and a polyphonic output, for setting out a chord or a scale by hand

params.text: Sets how many channels the polyphonic output carries; the individual outputs keep their own voltages whatever this is
Sets the note for that channel, C to B
Sets the octave for that channel, 0 to 8, where 4 holds middle C
Switches that channel's readout between sharp and flat note names
Sets how many semitones every channel is transposed by
Transposes every channel up one semitone
Transposes every channel down one semitone

inputs.text: Transposes the channels by the voltage here, at a volt per octave and apart from the knob; a monophonic signal moves every channel, and a polyphonic one moves each channel by its own
Adds to the number of channels on the polyphonic output, a channel per volt

outputs.text: The fixed 1V/octave voltage of the note set for that channel
The chosen number of channels, each carrying the note voltage of that channel

notes: the module needs nothing patched into it; every channel output carries its note voltage as soon as the module is added
menu: Label Text sets the name shown in the readout at the top, which is saved with the patch and with presets
